steps.name: Necessidades
steps.task: Frame the needs as jobs to be done, separating explicit from latent needs.

steps.name: Benchmark
steps.task: Analyse at least three competitor apps: value proposition, monetisation, features, strengths, weaknesses, privacy stance. Give a feature matrix.

steps.name: Priorizar
steps.task: Prioritise with RICE or MoSCoW and show the reasoning.

steps.name: Especificar
steps.task: Write user stories with testable acceptance criteria and the domain edge cases.
